sql:
SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS table,c.relkind AS kind,
obj_description(c.oid,'pg_class') AS description,c.reltuples::bigint AS estimated_rows,
has_schema_privilege(n.oid,'USAGE') AS schema_usage,has_table_privilege(c.oid,'SELECT') AS table_select,
base.sources,base.accessible AS source_access
FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT bool_and(has_schema_privilege(bn.oid,'USAGE') AND has_table_privilege(b.oid,'SELECT')) AS accessible,
string_agg(DISTINCT bn.nspname||'.'||b.relname,',') AS sources
FROM pg_rewrite rw JOIN pg_depend dep ON dep.classid='pg_rewrite'::regclass AND dep.objid=rw.oid AND dep.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass
JOIN pg_class b ON b.oid=dep.refobjid AND b.oid<>c.oid JOIN pg_namespace bn ON bn.oid=b.relnamespace WHERE rw.ev_class=c.oid) base ON true
WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','p','f') AND n.nspname ~ '^(csmar|wind)' ORDER BY 1,2
